title: Define error summarization and focus walkthrough for conditional form sections
creator: Maya Singh
description: Problem: Complex forms that reveal conditional sections (advanced settings, billing details, connector options) produce noisy inline errors and unclear guidance when users submit. Current patterns scatter errors across hidden sections or rely on a generic top banner with no clear focus or voice. We need a consistent error-summary pattern plus keyboard focus/walkthrough that: aggregates validation issues, signals priority for actionable fixes, reveals hidden sections as needed, and preserves accessible announcements for screen readers. This ticket scopes design decisions, microcopy, keyboard flows, and token-level visual specs for the pattern. Outcome: a spec and Figma components that engineering can implement in the component library and Console routes with minimal heuristic code changes.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Error summary component defined with hierarchy: critical summary message, grouped list of errors, and per-error jump links that focus and expand hidden sections.

A2: Keyboard walkthrough behavior documented: on submit with errors, focus moves to the error summary; pressing Enter on a listed error expands the section (if collapsed) and sets focus to the relevant form control without additional tabbing.
A3: Accessibility requirements captured: ARIA alerts/role="status" for live regions, unique IDs for link targets, and screen-reader phrasing examples for NVDA/VoiceOver/JAWS.

A4: Visual specs (tokens) for error summary and inline error states across density modes defined: color token references, spacing, elevation, and iconography, with a compact variant for narrow surfaces.
A5: Figma file with components and variants added, and a short dev handoff page with implementation notes and example PR skeleton.
A6: A/B suggestion for microcopy tested with 10 internal support reps for clarity and reduced escalations (results in Confluence notes).
A7: Dependencies and required engineering APIs documented (expand/collapse programmatic hooks, focusTo(controlId), analytics event names).
comments: 2026-02-20 — MS: Spiked two approaches: (1) top-level aggregated banner with per-error anchors, (2) inline modal walkthrough that steps through errors. Leaning to (1) because it maps cleanly to current Console layouts and requires fewer runtime primitives.

2026-02-24 — JK: Engineering concerns noted in sync: we need a stable control ID prop and an 'ensureVisible' API to scroll+expand collapsed groups. ENG asked for a spec for signal names for telemetry.

2026-02-28 — Design review: consensus on grouping errors by section > field, and adding a severity pin (error/warning). Requested microcopy alternatives A/B test for 'Fix issues' vs 'Review errors'. Action: designers to run quick support-squad test.

2026-03-03 — UX research: ran internal hallway test with 12 participants. Key finding: users preferred upfront summary that says how many issues and which sections ("2 errors in Billing, 1 in Connectors"). Added copy with section counts.

2026-03-07 — Accessibility review (from Security & Compliance): recommended explicit role="alert" for the summary when submission fails and role="status" for non-blocking warnings. Also requested keyboard specification for Enter vs Space handling on anchors.
2026-03-10 — PRD link added to Confluence and first Figma iteration uploaded. Design paired with ENG on expected API surface: focusTo(fieldId), revealSection(sectionId), listErrors(formState) helper.

2026-03-12 — JK: Implemented a prototype branch that wires focusTo and revealSection. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1234 — requesting design review for microcopy and spacing tokens before merging.
2026-03-12 — MS: Updated acceptance criteria to include compact variant and token mapping. Leaving final sign-off to Design Lead and Accessibility specialist.
2026-03-12 — QA note: Add automated test seeds that simulate collapsed section errors and keyboard navigation scenario.
Next steps: finalize copy A/B, finalize token values with design tokens team, and coordinate 1-week dev iteration for the console routes that have dense multi-section forms.
